protocol.name: v7-full-update-perturbation-v1
protocol.perturbation: five source types, fixed random signs; retinal clamp unperturbed
protocol.linearization: time-varying mixed-update Jacobian along the unperturbed trajectory
protocol.counterfactual: unit slope in tangent interface only; nominal state unchanged
protocol.rounding: finite-replay tangent initialized from realized float32 half-difference

limitations: Finite-time amplification for two directions is not an asymptotic Lyapunov exponent.
Clipping and threshold crossings can invalidate local linear predictions.
Float32 roundoff can dominate very small trajectory differences.
Unit-slope tangent is an algebraic diagnostic, not a deployable counterfactual model.
No model, normalizer, published visual score, or default policy was modified.
